Repair both BaseForm.process extra_filters and Form.validate extra_validators as one caller-ownership bug family. Before appending an inline rule, copy only that used field sequence; do not mutate caller lists, deep-copy callable objects, reorder explicit-extra before inline, or eagerly consume unrelated unused extra-field generators. Support list/tuple sequences, repeat construction/process/validate, inheritance and real error propagation. Each inline runs once per current processing/validation cycle. Preserve all original field/validator semantics and leave already-correct default behavior unchanged.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_wtforms_01_dev.py, and Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-wtforms-01-dev.md. Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.

Add wtforms.data_optional.DataOptional as opt-in Optional subclass. When raw_data is present, keep original Optional request/explicit-empty semantics, including clearing earlier processing errors for a deliberately empty request. Without submitted raw_data, use processed field.data: None/empty selected containers/empty string or configured whitespace is optional; 0 and False are real values and continue validators. Never erase an object conversion error merely because resulting data is None. Preserve old Optional untouched and use original StopValidation/field_flags/validator order. Document empty-container and whitespace policies explicitly.

Add wtforms.jsondata.JSONFormData implementing getlist, iteration, contains, length and first-value lookup. Snapshot a top-level JSON mapping into standard hyphen form paths: objects recurse, lists use numeric FieldList indices unless the complete path is explicitly listed in multi_values for SelectMultiple. Define None as present empty string, booleans true/false, finite numbers decimal text, strings unchanged; missing keys stay absent and explicit empty multi-value list stays present. Reject hyphen-containing/empty/nonstring keys, path collisions, unsupported objects/nonfinite numbers, excessive depth/value budget and malformed roots. Preserve caller ownership and never auto-treat arbitrary dict formdata or change data/obj semantics. Validate with actual FormField/FieldList/SelectMultiple processing and nested error locations.

Add wtforms.derive.derive_form(base,name,fields,remove=(),replace=False) returning a new Form class through its actual metaclass. Preserve inherited Meta/inline validators and deterministic base-field order, append new mapping-order fields, keep overridden fields in their original slot and support explicit inherited-field removal. Reject reserved/private/invalid names, non-UnboundField values, unknown removals, simultaneous remove/readd and accidental override without replace=True. Do not mutate parent class, caches, field creation counters or existing instances; independent derived forms bind independent Field objects. This is a supported dynamic-class construction feature, not a claim existing WTForms cannot use type()/BaseForm at all.

Add wtforms.batch.validate_records(form_class,records,multi_values=(),max_records=None,stop_on_error=False) yielding independent RecordResult(index,record_id,valid,data,errors). Consume (id,JSON payload) records lazily, use the earlier explicit JSONFormData adapter with actual Form.validate and nested fields, preserve duplicate/arbitrary original IDs and input order, and snapshot processed data/errors. First next must not preconsume later records; zero budget does not consume; optional first-error stops after yielding that failure. Exceeding a finite budget raises with explicit partial-results meaning (one extra record may be read to detect excess), never claim whole-stream success. Programming/source/validator exceptions propagate, and no files/network/HTTP services are accessed.
